


function toggleAccordion(element)
{
    if ($(element).hasClass('active')) {
        $(element).removeClass('active');
        $(element).next('.accordion-content').hide('fast');
    }
    else {
        $('#mainframe').find('.accordion-header').removeClass('active');
        $(element).addClass('active');
        $('#mainframe').find('.accordion-content').hide('fast');
        $(element).next('.accordion-content').show('fast');
    }
}

function setupApp()
{
    $('#mainframe').find('.accordion-content').hide();
    $('#mainframe').find('.accordion-header').click(function () {
        toggleAccordion(this);
    });
    $('.optionListItem').each(function () {
        if ($(this).data('icon')) {
            $(this).prepend('<i class="fa fa-fw ' + $(this).data('icon') + '"></i>');
        }
    });
    $('a.external').attr('target', '_blank');
    $('.js-google-map').each(function()
    {
        var data = $(this).data();
        initializeMap($(this).attr('id'), data['zoom'], data['place']);

    })
}

function initializeMap(mapId, zoom, location)
{
    var coords = {"lat" : location.address.lat, "lng" : location.address.long};
    var mapOptions = {
        "center" : coords,
        "zoom" : zoom
    };

    var map = new google.maps.Map(document.getElementById(mapId), mapOptions);
    var marker = new google.maps.Marker({
        position: coords,
        map: map,
        title: location.venue.name
    });

    var infoWindowContent = '<strong>' + location.venue.name + '</strong><br />' +
        location.address.street + '<br />' +
        location.address.city + ', ' + location.address.state + ' ' + location.address.zip + '<br />' +
        '<strong>Hours:</strong> ';
    if (location.venue.hours.length > 1) {
        for(var index in location.venue.hours) {
            infoWindowContent += '<br />' + location.venue.hours[index];
        }
    } else {
        infoWindowContent += location.venue.hours[0];
    }

    infoWindowContent = '<div class="js-map-info-window">' + infoWindowContent + '</div>'

    var info = new google.maps.InfoWindow({
        "content" : infoWindowContent
    });
    info.open(map, marker);
}
